577207.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Suffern
577207.note: No source found (its own site gives no year). therebbesimpact.com: 2007; chabad.org's listing number (577207) is from about 2007 too; the IRS ruling for Congregation Chabad Jewish Center of Suffern Inc. is March 2010. Directed by Rabbi Shmuel and Devorah Gancz (the directory still names Rabbi Isaac Lefkowitz). Its chabad.org listing went up on Oct 9 2007 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 123 Route 59, Suffern (Feb 2010, Nov 2011, Jan 2015); it is now at 350 Haverstraw Road, Montebello, listed there by Apr 2016, so it moved there between Jan 2015 and Apr 2016. Its listing was already archived in June 2008, after the listing went up (Oct 9 2007), so this adds no earlier bound. New York's register: CHABAD JEWISH CENTER OF SUFFERN, INC., filed 2008-04-14, after its chabad.org listing (2007-10-09), so not the year (HANDOFF 4b).

earlier.where: 123 Route 59, Suffern (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Feb 11 2010 to Jan 23 2015)

118267.name: Agudas Chassidei Chabad
118267.note: Wikipedia: 'In 1940, after arriving in the United States, Schneersohn became president, effectively making the American branch the worldwide organization base'; Agudas Chasidei Chabad bought 770 Eastern Parkway in 1940 (Wikipedia, 770 Eastern Parkway). Founded by the Rebbe Rayatz in 1923; 'The American branch existed at least as far back as 1927' (elsewhere in New York, before Crown Heights). (Crown Heights, owner Nov 10: do the 12 real mosdos; the year it began in America, not in Europe or Eretz Yisroel.) New York's register also has AGUDAS HACHSIDIM ANSHAI CHABADD OF UNITED STATES, INC., a not-for-profit filed 1924-07-29 in Kings County (Brooklyn), so an American Agudas body existed from 1924; 1940 is kept as the year it became the movement's base at 770 (owner to decide).
